title: YourBench: Easy Custom Evaluation Sets for Everyone
findings: The YourBench framework successfully replicated the MMLU 'World Religions' subset. The automatically generated questions were more challenging (resulted in lower absolute accuracy scores) for all tested models but perfectly preserved the relative performance ranking of the models compared to the original MMLU subset (Spearman correlation of 1.0).
